cd "E:\Projects\Portfolio\server" && node -e "
const YahooFinance = require('yahoo-finance2').default
const yf = new YahooFinance()
const end = new Date(); const start = new Date(); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 90)
const fmt = d => d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
yf.historical('POLI.TA', { period1: fmt(start), period2: fmt(end), interval: '1d' })
  .then(r => console.log('rows:', r.length, 'first:', JSON.stringify(r[0])))
  .catch(e => console.error('ERROR:', e.message))
" 2>&1
